Meta’s Muse AI Assistant Rolled Out With a Serious Security Flaw
stories.abstract: Meta patched a critical vulnerability in its Muse AI assistant that allowed unauthorized remote code execution on macOS. The flaw enabled attackers to bypass security protections and gain full control over a victim's system through malicious interactions.
stories.why: AI agents with broad system permissions introduce significant new attack vectors that can bypass traditional endpoint security controls.
stories.action: Update the Meta Muse application to the latest version immediately.

InfraTrust report warns network management systems under attack
stories.abstract: Threat actors are shifting focus toward enterprise network management platforms. These systems, which provide centralized control over infrastructure, are being exploited via critical vulnerabilities, often occurring immediately following or even preceding official vendor disclosure and patch availability.
stories.why: Compromising management systems grants attackers broad administrative control over the entire network, facilitating lateral movement and persistent access.

SolarWinds security advisory (AV26-950)
stories.abstract: SolarWinds has disclosed multiple vulnerabilities affecting self-hosted Observability instances prior to version 2026.2.3. These flaws include critical remote code execution risks that could allow unauthenticated attackers to compromise affected systems.
stories.why: Remote code execution vulnerabilities in observability platforms provide attackers with a direct path to internal network infrastructure and sensitive monitoring data.
stories.action: Update SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted to version 2026.2.3 or later.

SharePoint Flaw Initially Listed as Spoofing by Microsoft Enables Authenticated RCE
stories.abstract: Microsoft misclassified a SharePoint Server vulnerability, CVE-2026-65660, as a minor spoofing issue. Security researchers discovered the flaw actually permits authenticated remote code execution across SharePoint Server 2016, 2019, and Subscription Edition, significantly increasing the risk profile of the previously downplayed bug.
stories.why: Authenticated attackers can achieve remote code execution, allowing them to compromise the server and potentially escalate privileges within the SharePoint environment.
stories.action: Apply the latest security updates for SharePoint Server immediately.

A congressional representative just proposed killing America’s border tower program
stories.abstract: Representative Delia Ramirez plans to introduce legislation aimed at dismantling the surveillance tower network currently deployed along the United States southern border. This proposal follows recent investigative reporting highlighting concerns regarding the program's efficacy and its role in border-related fatalities.
stories.why: The potential removal of these surveillance assets would significantly alter the technical landscape and operational visibility of border security infrastructure.
